packageRules.description: Terraform provider and GitHub Actions updates always require human review
Keep k3s bootstrap updates isolated and explicitly high risk
prBodyNotes: **High-risk, bootstrap-only update:** this changes the k3s version rendered into cloud-init for instance creation/rebuild. The compute module ignores OCI instance metadata changes, so this does not upgrade existing nodes. Review this dependency update independently. Any apply must be manually dispatched and approved through the `terraform-apply` environment, which must be configured with required reviewers.

customManagers.description: Track the k3s version used only by cloud-init bootstrap
